record.text:
OG was a -11 despite going 20/10/8.

I see the Celtics took 87 shots to the Knicks 80 even though the Knicks won the rebounds all around. The turnover battle murdered us.

The Knicks were better than the Celtics in virtually every metric available but lost the turnover battle 16-7, which seems to me was the difference in the game.

Honestly, not that mad at the general game execution otherwise. -9 on turnovers and missed 6 free throws in a 4 point loss. That’s it.
